flags.html_text: For each atomic formula there is a corresponding experiment which may either fail or succeed, but may show dispersion, i.e., it may yield different results when repeated. A fixed failure probability, called risk value, is assigned to each experiment and thus to each atomic formula. The players have to pay ⟦M⟧ 1 to the other player for each of their atomic assertion where the associated experiments fails.
